title: Complete the shared debug command language contract
platforms: Windows GNU; Wine/Xvfb EUR and synthetic interpreter
changes: Accept DBG2-13 after reconciling its language, shared operations, ID selection, job controls, channel parity and malformed-input criteria; synchronize the Atlas task reference and durable project state.
validation: The shared typed parser and action dispatch cover help/status, pause/step, inspection, PC/watch searches, captures/reports, profile/catalog selection and jobs. Same-seed CLI/menu/console inspection and step endpoints matched exactly; code/gameplay, audio, Recent, graphics and issue-report checks exercised the applicable channels. Replay, cancellation, retry and selected-profile outcomes have earlier linked evidence.

Wine parser and GUI checks rejected selected malformed, ambiguous, unknown and out-of-range inputs without guest mutation. Synthetic replay, pending-request and host-worker checks verified aligned direct controls and preserved ownership/cancellation. The latest Windows GNU builds and 7 menu/8 workbench/34 control/10 command Wine tests passed.
limitations: Acceptance is for the DBG2-13 command-language contract, not every runtime/input/platform combination. Native Windows, physical input and a live audit-enabled watch hit remain part of DBG2-27; DBG2-14 and subsequent tasks remain open.
